scripts.api:dev: cd api && DOTNET_WATCH_RESTART_ON_RUDE_EDIT=1 dotnet watch run
scripts.api:test: npm run api:test:unit && npm run api:test:integration
scripts.api:check: dotnet build api/Tools.Api.csproj && npm run api:test
scripts.java:build: cd api-java && mvn clean package && cd ..
scripts.web:build: cd web && npm run test && npm run build && cd ..
scripts.electron:build: cd web && npm run electron:build && cd ..
